newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity names managers to two funds.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity names managers to two funds.

text.p: Fidelity Investments said Tuesday it named Stephen DuFour as manager of the equity portion of the $3.9 billion Fidelity Balanced Fund.
Kevin Grant will continue to manage the fixed-income portion of Fidelity Balanced Fund.
DuFour succeeds Stephen Petersen, who will continue to manage the $17.2 billion Fidelity Equity-Income Fund and the $8.1 billion Fidelity Variable Insurance Products Fund: Equity-Income Portfolio.
In addition, Fidelity named David Felman as manager of the $1.1 billion Fidelity Convertible Securities Fund, succeeding DuFour.

Felman had managed an institutional account most recently, and had previously managed Fidelity Select Telecommunications Portfolio from 1994 to 1996 and was an assistant for the Fidelity Magellan Fund.
